scan.viltrumitecore.regulus.lion_heart: Lion's Heart: his time is stopped — nothing reaches him
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_lions_hea:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>1s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Toggle

<grey>Stop your own time. No damage, push or effect
<grey>reaches you; blows recoil 30% onto the attacker,
<grey>projectiles stop dead in the air.
<grey>Your heart stops too: without a living host
<grey>(Little King) strain rises and after ~5 s
<grey>the heart seizes (Lion locked for 8 s).

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_stopped_s:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>6s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Cast

<grey>Scoop the dust at your feet and throw it:
<grey>9 grains, each stopped in time, fly 40 blocks,
<grey>pierce up to 3 enemies (4, in Lion 6)
<grey>and break soft blocks where the world allows.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_air_sever:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>9s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Cast

<grey>Fling a sheet of stopped air thin as glass:
<grey>it widens from 3 to 9 blocks over 30 blocks and cuts
<grey>through enemies (12, in Lion 18) and blocks up to stone.
<grey>Sneak for a vertical cut.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_processio:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>12s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Cast

<grey>Lion only. Walk straight ahead for 2.5 s at your own
<grey>unhurried pace: whatever stands in the way is struck (10)
<grey>and blocks up to obsidian-weak break where allowed.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_right_of_:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>6s / 10s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Stance

<grey>Raise a pane of stopped air for half a second:
<grey>the first blow stops against it and is answered
<grey>with a strike (8 + half the blocked damage).

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_kingdom_o:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>100s
<grey>Type: <yellow>Ultimate

<grey>Judge one target within 32 blocks: it freezes, the air
<grey>around it is gathered into a dome of stopped grains,
<grey>five waves strike it (4 each), then one flick of a finger
<grey>(16) launches it and cracks the ground. 7.5 s; ends
<grey>safely if the target dies, escapes or leaves.

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_greeds_to:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>—
<grey>Type: <yellow>Combo (LMB, empty hand)

<grey>A bored touch in stopped time: backhand, palm, flick.
<grey>Up to 3 targets in front of you; in Lion the flick
<grey>leaves a rupture inside the body (8 after 0.5 s).

<blue>Regulus
ability.viltrumitecore.regulus_little_ki:
<grey>Cooldown: <lime>—
<grey>Type: <yellow>Heart key (MMB)

<grey>Place your heart in a living being within 6 blocks
<grey>(up to 4 subjects). The heart lives in one host and moves
<grey>on every 20 s; while it lives the Lion has no time limit.
<grey>Press again on a subject to free it; sneak to free all.

<blue>Regulus
subtitle.viltrumitecore.regulus.ult_accu: You have been infringing on my rights all this time. Do you even understand that?
subtitle.viltrumitecore.regulus.ult_sent: I am satisfied with what I have. That is why I will not let you take a grain of it.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.regulus.ult_flic: That is all. A single individual, complete in himself.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.regulus.king: Be grateful. You may carry my heart.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.regulus.reply: I have the right to answer that.
subtitle.viltrumitecore.regulus.host_los: How inconsiderate. To die while carrying my heart.
subtitles.viltrumitecore.regulus_grain_s: A grain stops in the air
